method: GitHub search over topic:mcp-server, topic:model-context-protocol, topic:mcp and 'mcp server' in name/description, sorted by stars; every candidate read through the API before it was kept. A launch command is recorded only where an MCP handshake (initialize -> tools/list) completed in this environment, or where the repository's README states it and npm/PyPI serves the named package. Everything else is carried as an import with the command left empty - the component never guesses a command.
